title: detect-conditional-lenses: `git ls-files ... || true` makes an empty tracked set indistinguishable from an untyped stack, silently declaring L13 N/A while the round still records round_type=full
_rr_validate_output captures `rc` and never reads it, so a failed or phantom-prefix `edm-state validate` scores as perfect State health
A failed `get-coverage` empties the framework signal, marks Test stack and Coverage posture N/A, and removes them from the overall-score denominator -- the read failure raises the score
CH_CALIBRATION_AVAILABLE defaults to true and only flips on a literal 'insufficient data' match, so a metrics-report failure silently awards the calibration-data points
`try fromjson catch {}` plus `$payload[$c.field] // ""` turns an empty, unparseable or field-drifted payload into a clean exit 0 -- a block rule silently stops enforcing
`{command: (.tool_input.command // "")}` always succeeds, so the non-empty guard can never fire and a payload-shape drift disables every bash-event rule with no signal
A dying `edm-state validate` is skipped with `continue` and zero output, so a systematic validate failure makes the Stop gate exit 0 silently on every Stop
gg_record_denial fails silently on an unwritable state dir, so the denial budget never accrues and the gate denies every edit forever while json deny mode (exit 0) hides the advisory
jq projections with `2>/dev/null` under `set -e` abort the hook before any decision is emitted -- zero bytes on stdout and stderr, gate fails open invisibly
Pattern-library seed path from `get-patterns | sed -n '1p'` is never checked non-empty at four call sites, so a failed resolution silently produces an ungrounded SRD/ticket pack/coverage report
The citation-orphan check is wrapped in `if [[ -f "$CANON_DOC" ]]` with no else, so a missing canonical-sections.md makes the whole check silently not run and exit 0 clean
--gateguard measures through _measure_p95's `|| true` with no correctness probe, so an aborting gateguard prints budget_status=MET
The CA-471 completeness gate accepts any parseable bytes, so a placeholder lens-L{N}.jsonl satisfies it and the round converges having proved nothing about content
The three-way completeness backstop is gated on a pass directory and manifest existing, with no else -- a round that produced no pass directory closes silently as round_type=full
`command -v <bin> || exit 0` guards make each new hook a documented, deliberate silent no-op when its binary is off PATH
EDM_GATEGUARD_MAX_DENIALS is unvalidated, but a non-numeric value is a loud `unbound variable` abort under set -u rather than a silent coercion
